column1: # assets/chip_genes.tsv: the CHIP genes of step 49 and the variant classes it counts (docs/49-chip.md).
# Hand-curated from the papers in the pmids column. Codons and exons are those of the gene's MANE
# Select transcript in Ensembl's annotation (ENSEMBL_GFF_RELEASE in versions.env), which step 49
# truncating: which protein-truncating changes (frameshift, stop gained, splice donor or acceptor)
#   count: all, none, or exons:A-B (the exon of the change, numbered on that transcript).
# missense: which missense changes count, comma separated: none, all, a codon with its reference
#   residue (R882: any change of that residue), one exact change (V617F), a codon range (102-292)
# A change outside these classes is listed as other_change, not counted.
# bin/chip_report.py check-table checks the schema; tests/test_chip_report.py runs it.

column4: The most common CHIP gene. R882 is the hotspot of DNMT3A in acute myeloid leukaemia; other missense changes are listed, not counted.
